Speech Recognition-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Transcription marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general Dictation or Sound Recognition guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Speech Recognition permission claims:

语音识别 vs 语音识别权限 vs 语音转文字

US pages say "Speech Recognition", "Grant Speech Recognition access", or "Enable transcription in System Settings." China storefront copy often uses 语音识别 for general Speech Recognition positioning aligned with Settings → Privacy & Security → Speech Recognition, 语音识别权限 when the hero frame shows the permission rationale or access scope, and 语音转文字 when English source uses shorter speech-to-text phrasing on meeting or caption buyer frames. AppLocale picks commerce-idiomatic phrasing per frame — not 听写 on consumer Speech Recognition screenshots, not 声音识别 on transcription grant walkthroughs, and not 麦克风 on Apple transcription service onboarding.

Speech Recognition vs Dictation keyboard

Consumer Speech Recognition (语音识别权限) lets end users toggle per-app access to Apple on-device or server speech models for transcription in System Settings after consent. Dictation (听写) is keyboard voice typing into text fields — a different input UI story. English shares "speech-to-text" — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate consumer 语音识别 permission panels with 听写 keyboard mic buttons. Dictation frames belong on the Dictation listing guide when keyboard voice typing leads — not mixed into consumer Speech Recognition captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Speech Recognition vs Sound Recognition

Consumer Speech Recognition (语音识别) transcribes spoken audio into text using Apple speech models. Sound Recognition (声音识别) detects ambient environmental sounds like baby cries and smoke alarms for Accessibility alerts. English shares "recognition" — Chinese storefront copy must not conflate 语音识别 transcription panels with 声音识别 ambient alert dashboards. Sound Recognition frames belong on the Sound Recognition listing guide when ambient alerts lead — not mixed into Speech Recognition captions unless each frame is labeled honestly.

Speech Recognition vs Voice Isolation and Microphone-only TCC

Speech Recognition permission governs Apple transcription service access — 语音识别. Voice Isolation governs in-call mic beamforming during Phone and FaceTime — 人声隔离. Microphone permission governs raw microphone hardware access — 麦克风. A Speech Recognition grant toggle is not a Mic Mode picker and not a microphone-only rationale unless that is what the frame shows. Voice Isolation frames belong on the Voice Isolation listing guide when Mic Mode leads.
